snippet.title: El territorio que PERDIERON LAS PANDILLAS en Haití: Bukele avanza con OFENSIVA INÉDITA
snippet.description:
Una ofensiva militar sin precedentes sacude Haití. El despliegue de 2.500 militares salvadoreños, enviados por el presidente Nayib Bukele, busca desmantelar las pandillas que durante años han sometido a la población. La operación combina presencia terrestre, vigilancia aérea y ataques con drones.

Durante los primeros 21 días, los enfrentamientos y ataques con drones aumentaron un 45,8 %. Entre los principales golpes destaca la destrucción de la Casa de la Muerte, bastión de torturas y secuestros de la pandilla 400 Mawozo en Puerto Príncipe.

Según Bukele, El Salvador asume el 90 % de los costos de una misión que busca rescatar a cuatro aerotécnicos militares secuestrados por bandas criminales.

snippet.title: She Called This Lambo Broken 💀
snippet.description:

She notices the lightweight fabric pull-strap inside the Lamborghini and mistakes it for a cheap replacement for a missing door handle. But things get even more ridiculous when she pulls the strap and the door swings vertically upward instead of opening normally. Rather than realizing that she's looking at Lamborghini's iconic scissor doors, she assumes the door is broken and decides to walk away from the date. So after whats almost been a decade long search for the next James Bond we finally have the name that will be playing the character. Hell it might even be longer than 10 years as I remember even around skyfall people were like…man Idris Elba should be the next James Bond. But its something Ive stayed away from the reporting on the updates for because we’ve had a schoredingers bond situation where the boy who cried bond means that theres been countless names listed as being in the running, Elba, Cavill, tom hardy, aaron taylor johnson, tom holland, james norton, rege jean page, paul mescal, Aaron Taylor Johnson, Jack O’connel, tom hiddleston, richard madden, andrew garfield, theo james, dan stevens, michael fassbender, jamie dornan….the list goes on and on and yeah we’d be putting out a video every week that contradicted the one before. The next James Bond name is a place thats rife for clickbait and weve watched the press go into a frenzied death spiral where they just pump out article after article listing every actor ever until they have to go into hibernation for the next 27 years.
